title: A screen opened before the change still accepts the non-technician
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, leading no work, so switching Technician off shows no warning.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, so the list has a technician to compare with.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Approved, led by staff member B.
  • Have Settings, Staff open in a second browser tab.
  • Start on work order 1.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Lead Technician dropdown.
  2. Press the Escape key.
  3. Switch to the Settings, Staff tab.
  4. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  5. Switch Technician off.
  6. Click Save & Close.
  7. Switch to the work order 1 tab.
  8. In the Lead Technician dropdown, pick staff member A.
  9. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The dropdown offers staff member A.

Step 2:

  • The dropdown closes.

Step 3:

  • The staff list shows.

Step 4:

  • The window shows Technician on.

Step 5:

  • Technician is off.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and staff member A's row shows "No".

Step 7:

  • Work order 1 shows, not reloaded.

Step 8:

  • The lead changes to staff member A and is accepted, as today, with no error.

Step 9:

  • Work order 1 shows staff member A as its lead.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-N3: “Technician narrows only what is offered. A non-technician who is made lead or added to a labor line another way (an outside tool through the Public API, or a screen opened before the change) is accepted as today, and so is job time they record (S3-E3).”
  • Key Decisions: “Technician also decides only who is offered, not who can be assigned or record time: assignment and clocking are checked as today.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
